notes: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Hosted API first; clear intent to move to Dedicated if unit economics are favorable. POC focused on support-agent + doc-search for our enterprise customers.
notes_long:
- CTO (Ravi Mehta) quote on 02/18: "We need predictable per-conversation cost at scale, not surprises from token spikes."
- Primary asks: lat p95 ~150ms for short chat, sustained throughput 500-800 reqs/min during business hours, embeddings latency <120ms for search.
- Cost sensitivity: want per-month predictability; interested in committed reserved capacity + burst. Ask: how much can batching + prefix caching reduce cost for our 60% repeat-prefix traffic?
- Quantization: strong interest in 4-bit/8-bit profiles; want Redwood to surface recommended model/profile per workload (quality vs cost tradeoff).
- Workshop outcome expected: 1) recommended Dedicated sizing (GPUs, instance mix), 2) batching/caching config examples and measured unit economics, 3) pricing scenarios (hosted vs reserved) and ramp plan.
- Quote from Head of ML Ops: "Show us numbers — tokens saved, expected $/1000 requests for recommended config."
- Security: require VPC peering option + KMS integration, SOC2 required, data residency for EU customers (subset).
- Sales friction: procurement timeline (~6 weeks), legal wants SLA tweaks, security questionnaire ongoing (sent 2026-02-10).
- Links referenced: pricing deck (drive/Clifftop/Redwood/pricing-v1), POC plan (drive/Clifftop/Redwood/poc-plan-2026-01), security intake ticket (SEC-5123).
poa_summary: During evaluation: run hosted POC with hooks for metrics -> then 2-hour cost workshop. Workshop agenda: workload profiling, batching strategy, caching hits analysis, recommended quantization profiles, Dedicated sizing + pricing options. Deliverable: slide pack + unit-econ spreadsheet.
poc_metrics: Success criteria: doc-search MRR uplift 8% in pilot cohort, p95 chat latency <=150ms, embeddings recall delta <=1% vs baseline, cost per 1k queries reduced by >=30% using recommended configs.
pricing_notes: Prefers committed monthly reserved capacity with optional burst; asked for blended hosted-to-dedicated migration pricing; wants example contracts (12/24 month) and overage terms.
sales_comments: AE notes: warm exec sponsor (Ravi), procurement aligned to Q2 budget cycle. Recommend early legal engagement. Run Optimize workshop ASAP to lock value prop.
technical_comments: SE notes: significant repeat-prefix traffic (~60%), good candidate for prefix/KV caching. Model candidates: open-source Llama-family quantized 4-bit for embeddings and smaller chat backbone for routable fallbacks.
